description: T-fal's Performa cookware solves the problems of cooking with stainless steel! Performa Stainless Steel fry pans and saute pans feature the Techno Release raised pattern on the pan's interior for easier release of food and easier cleanup. Minimal effort should restore pans to their original beauty. All Performa cookware is constructed of premium quality 18/10 stainless steel and is compatible with all cooktops, including induction. The riveted stainless steel handles provide an ergonomic and secure grip. Performa Stainless Steel cookware is also dishwasher safe and oven safe. Preparing delicious meals with stainless steel has never been easier..
